title: Velo Tropical Ice Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (10mg)
description: Velo Slim Tropical Ice Nicotine Pouches bring together exotic Pineapple, creamy Coconut, juicy Mango and ripe Papaya, all finished with a refreshing cooling note. The result is a flavour that tastes sweet, fruity and bright, with an icy edge that enhances the tropical blend. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is delivered gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, making them a convenient option for everyday use. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide variety of flavour profiles and strengths. This Tropical Ice edition offers a Medium 10mg strength, providing a more potent release compared with the Mini range. How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
